Compute PC+4 before late redirect selection using ADS-documented syn_keep; generate kept PC+8 only for dual issue, avoiding unused single-issue hardware; identical PC priority, arithmetic and cycle behavior.

For native single issue, reuse a second existing 2-read single-write register file to pre-read both raw fetch slots and forward each before the original PC lane choice; same write/reset/x0/forward priority, issue eligibility and cycle.

Resolve six parallel operand bypass tag matches into an exclusive highest-priority case before selecting payload; preserve procedural unknown-tag comparisons, selected X/Z data, x0 and all states/cycles.

Single-issue MUL can forward the qualified unsigned16-bit E1 partial product to the next instruction; high multiply/load/dual issue preserve existing dependency policy and all cancellation/hold/ordering gates.

changes: Rename integration predictor and its unchanged local LFSR helper.
Select exact-PC and upper-word matches with highest-index one-hot masks; parallel bitwise AND/OR data selection preserves duplicate tags and original if/X comparison behavior.
Write each BTB entry directly using its highest-priority one-hot hit or the original miss-allocation index; BHT/RAS/training/LFSR state and cycles unchanged.
Adapt the fixed OpenTitan one-hot mux to flat Verilog ports; no additional compiler or runtime dependency.
Localize each BHT entry saturation transition after its address match, preserving counter/reset/condition priority and all cycles while avoiding a dynamic write-side counter read.

Compute exact-PC and upper-word highest-index priority masks in parallel before selecting the existing fallback; preserve original procedural if/X handling and all state/cycles. Keep the parallel masks as synthesis boundaries.

Share the 29 high tag bits between exact-PC and upper-word lookups; use kept three-bit equality groups for the complete query and write tags, preserving all 32 bits and procedural if/X semantics without state or cycle changes.

Extend lookup sharing to every bit except bit two, retaining low alignment bits; decode RAS actual/speculative write indices per entry before late prediction enables, preserving original confirmed-return/speculative-call overlap priority and all state/cycles.

Keep six-input partial AND reductions for the full tag equality and reuse the verified three-term/six-input balanced AND-OR implementation in the existing single payload selector; same four-state Boolean values, table state, priority and cycles.

Implement unchanged highest-entry priority with six-entry local/global lookahead in installed Pango LUT6 primitives; OR6 INIT fffffffffffffffe and own-match/no-higher INIT 2, same bitwise four-state function and no state. Larger optional tables retain original expression.

Reuse native group hit reductions for PC/upper/write hits; choose valid directly with original procedural priority. Read even/odd BHT word banks in parallel before the late index LSB, preserving >=2 comparison and explicit X for unknown low address; no state or cycle change.
Keep a shared sequential PC+8 sum before both late prediction selections, preventing late control from entering the increment carry; same arithmetic and cycles.
Select independently checked512-entry direct-mapped native-RAM BTB backend without adding prediction latency; retain shared BHT/RAS and legacy associative backend.
